summary.answer: Hides the vertical scrollbar when totalYDistance is zero. Otherwise shows it and computes the displayed fraction from (viewHeight - totalYDistance) / viewHeight; top-anchored and bottom-anchored branches set different top/bottom percentages from currentYOffset. No zero-height guard is shown. Uses 500/50 scroll-repeat values and defaults an absent target to the root. Interactive mode enables up/down mouse buttons and registers bar press/release/lose-focus/capture-lost/close/drag handlers plus background paging. Press asserts unlocked focus, captures the mouse and saves contact offsets. Release/lose-focus/close release capture and clear state; capture-lost clears state. Drag clamps normalized Y, optionally reverses it and scrolls. The disabled branch keeps bar/background unfocusable on updates.
